title: 打醬油 · A Life Along the River
readingDirection: RIGHT_TO_LEFT (x=1 is the start, x=0 is the end of the scroll)

home.name: 小安的家 Home
home.note: Thatched farmhouse in the misty countryside, just left of the donkey caravan. Folding the phone always returns here.

acts.name: 第一幕 · 打醬油 The Soy Sauce Errand
acts.intro: 娘說：「安兒，去虹橋那邊給娘打一瓶醬油回來。」Mother hands Xiao An ten copper coins and an empty bottle.

missions.title: 驢隊迷路 The Lost Donkey
missions.task: A charcoal seller lost track of his donkeys. Find the donkey caravan.

missions.title: 問路 Ask for Directions
missions.task: Find the travelers riding donkeys on the willow path and ask the way to the river.

missions.title: 拉縴 Help the Boatmen
missions.task: Boatmen are struggling to pole their boat under the willow. Find them and lend a hand.

missions.title: 虹橋驚魂 Chaos at the Bridge
missions.task: A big boat is about to crash into the Rainbow Bridge! Find it and shout a warning.

missions.title: 打醬油 Buy the Soy Sauce
missions.task: Find the market stalls at the foot of the bridge and buy the soy sauce.

missions.title: 回家 Go Home
missions.task: Fold the phone to bring the soy sauce home to Mother.

acts.outro: 娘笑了。Years pass… Xiao An grows up. At the Rainbow Bridge, life forks in two.

acts.name: 第二幕 · 考狀元 The Scholar's Path
acts.intro: Xiao An chooses the brush. He travels to the capital to sit the imperial examination.

missions.title: 借書 Borrow Books
missions.task: Find the tall festive gate of the restaurant where scholars gather.

missions.title: 入京 Enter the Capital
missions.task: Find the great city gate tower.

missions.title: 胡商 The Silk Road Merchant
missions.task: A camel merchant sells rare ink. Find the camel caravan.

missions.title: 詩會 Poetry Contest
missions.task: Win a poetry contest at the licensed tavern 正店.

missions.title: 高中狀元 Top Scholar
missions.task: An official in a sedan chair carries the exam results. Find him.

acts.ending: 金榜題名！Xiao An becomes the Top Scholar — and sends Mother the finest soy sauce in the capital.

acts.name: 第二幕 · 神偷 The Gentleman Thief
acts.intro: Xiao An chooses the shadows — a Robin Hood thief who steals from the greedy rich to feed the poor.

missions.title: 糧船 The Hoarded Grain
missions.task: A greedy merchant hoards grain on a barge. Find it.

missions.title: 水路 The Escape Boat
missions.task: Find a boat on the open water for a quiet getaway.

missions.title: 牛車 The Ox Cart
missions.task: Hide among the goods on the ox cart to slip into the city.

missions.title: 轎中錢袋 The Purse in the Sedan
missions.task: A corrupt official rides in a sedan chair. Lift his purse.

missions.title: 夜出城門 Out Through the Gate
missions.task: Escape through the city gate and give the silver to the poor.

acts.ending: The poor of Bianjing eat well tonight. No one ever learns the name of the thief — except Mother.
